name: Camp Hadar
description_short: Co-ed day camp for ages 5-15 on 17 acres of woods and sandy beach on Captain's Pond in Salem, New Hampshire. Camp runs 9:00 am to 4:00 pm, with optional busing from Massachusetts for an extra fee.
swim_waterfront_notes: Camp is on a sandy beach on Captain's Pond. The page does not describe swim instruction or waterfront supervision.

sources.note: Drafted by the listing tool from this page

source.title: Camp Hadar - Co-Ed Day Camp on Captain's Pond, Salem, NHCamp Hadar

warnings: The only season shown is 2026, and it ended before today (2026-10-13). There are no 2027 dates or prices yet.
The page gives discounts but no base prices: $10 off per week for early registration before 5/31, $20 off per week for new campers, and $75 off per week for CITs.
The page contradicts itself on Leaders In Training grades: one place says '8th and 9th Graders' and another says '7th, 8th, and 9th Graders'.
The mailing address (PO Box 254, Wakefield, MA) is different from the camp's location in Salem, NH.
The FAQ link asks 'Does my child need to be Jewish?' and the page says it welcomes children of all faiths. Whether the camp has a religious affiliation is not stated.
unknowns: Whether extended care is offered beyond 9:00 am-4:00 pm
Whether lunch or meals are included
Whether the camp is ACA accredited
